title: Native unbounded derived tensor commutes with etale inverse image
statement: For every morphism f:X → Y, arbitrary commutative ring sheaf R on Y_et, and additive module functor p left adjoint to actual direct image with inverse-image coefficients S=f^{-1}R, any functor d on the unbounded derived categories equipped with Q ⋙ d ≅ p_on_complexes ⋙ Q preserves native tensor: tensor_Y ⋙ d ≅ (d × d) ⋙ tensor_X. No closed immersion, open complement, exceptional adjunction, dualizing object, boundedness, perfectness or constancy assumption occurs.

source.place: Tensor-pullback input in the projection identity; Stacks Modules on Sites 03EL and Cohomology on Sites 07A4, 0G7E.

proof.text: Use the ring and module Hom equivalences to obtain underlying-set isomorphisms normalized on unit sections. These are constructed in etaleUnderlyingUnits. A sheaf map out of inverse image is determined by its adjunct. On unit sections ring maps preserve addition, multiplication, zero and one, and the module unit preserves addition, zero and scalar multiplication through the ring unit. Naturality of the set unit therefore transports all operation graphs, giving etaleAlgebraicPresentation with modules literally p.

Construct the scalar-extension functor explicitly from sectionwise extendScalars and module sheafification. For identity coefficients its natural isomorphism with identity comes from extendScalarsId and the sheafification counit. The universe-generalized private proofs preserve all functor and naturality laws. Thus U = I.modules followed by identity scalar extension is canonically isomorphic to p and exact; its derived functor is left derived via its invertible homotopy-localization factorization. Obtain the uniquely normalized ordinary tensor comparison from the existing canonical ringed tensor comparison theorem.

Build the native representative isomorphisms on flat-term K-flat complexes by tensorIso and tensorIso_naturality. Apply ringedTopoiCanonicalDerivedTensorPullback at independent site-object and site-Hom universes to the explicit presentation and actual module right adjoint; it supplies the natural derived tensor isomorphism. Transport the exact derived U through the identity-extension isomorphism to exact derived p, then to d by uniqueness of localization lifts through the supplied Q factorization. This proves the displayed functor isomorphism without an unproved new statement.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleNativeTensorPullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (p : closedCostalkEtaleModules Y R ⥤
      closedCostalkEtaleModules X ((closedCostalkEtaleRingPullback f).obj R))
    [p.Additive] (a : p ⊣ closedCostalkEtaleModulePush f R)
    (d : DerivedCategory (closedCostalkEtaleModules Y R) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (closedCostalkEtaleModules X ((closedCostalkEtaleRingPullback f).obj R)))
    (factors : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ d ≅
      p.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) :
    let S := (closedCostalkEtaleRingPullback f).obj R
    let tY := @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _
      (RingedDerivedNative.monoidal.{u + 1, u, 0, u + 2} Y.smallEtaleTopology R)
    let tX := @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _
      (RingedDerivedNative.monoidal.{u + 1, u, 0, u + 2} X.smallEtaleTopology S)
    Nonempty (tY ⋙ d ≅ d.prod d ⋙ tX)
